title: MWS 8-year resurvey — Behavioral
description: Diet, alcohol, and smoking behaviors reported at the 8-year resurvey.

F2FQORGN.title: Frequency of eating organic food
F2FQORGN.$comment: Available on every questionnaire version -- no -1 code here, unlike resurvey_3yr's F1FQORGN (which is unavailable on the two earliest 3-year-resurvey versions).

F25YDIET.title: Major diet changes in the last 5 years

F2ALCNUM.title: Alcoholic drinks per week
F2ALCNUM.$comment: Steward gave the real questionnaire's printed skip instruction directly: 'If you have less than one drink a week, please go to question 60' -- unlike resurvey_3yr's F1ALCNUM (D058, confirmed no skip), this wave's questionnaire genuinely routes around the two follow-up questions when F2ALCNUM=0. This field itself is still answered directly (0 for a non-drinker, a real value) -- D092. Real-count ceiling 96 (not arbitrary -- follows from the source's own 97 code, '97+'), 97/99 kept as their own const branches, matching resurvey_3yr's F1ALCNUM treatment (D061).

F2ALCEAT.title: Drinks alcohol with meals
F2ALCEAT.x-universe: Participants who have at least one alcoholic drink per week (F2ALCNUM != 0).
F2ALCEAT.$comment: not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F2ALCNUM=0 -- D092, steward-confirmed real printed skip instruction ('go to question 60'). Unlike resurvey_3yr's F1ALCEAT (D058, confirmed genuinely not skipped) -- a real difference between waves, not assumed.

F2ALCDAY.title: Number of drinking days per week
F2ALCDAY.x-universe: Participants who have at least one alcoholic drink per week (F2ALCNUM != 0).
F2ALCDAY.$comment: not_applicable branch enforced by the same mother-file skip pair as F2ALCEAT -- D092. Bound 0-7 follows from the field's own 'per week' framing, same reasoning as resurvey_3yr's F1ALCDAY (D061).

F2DRTEA.title: Tea consumption
F2DRTEA.$comment: Steward confirmed the alcohol skip ('go to question 60') does not extend to the tea/coffee questions -- these are asked of every participant regardless of F2ALCNUM. Same bound/treatment as resurvey_3yr's F1DRTEA (D061).

F2DRCOF.title: Coffee consumption
F2DRCOF.$comment: Same structure and reasoning as F2DRTEA -- not skipped by the alcohol routing.

F2SMOKE.title: Smoking status
F2SMOKE.$comment: Source marks this field 'Derived' for every questionnaire version -- it is not asked directly; F2CIGSPD's own question wording is what's actually printed. Skip pair against F2CIGSPD enforced by the mother file -- D093.

F2CIGSPD.title: Cigarettes per day
F2CIGSPD.x-universe: Participants who have ever smoked (F2SMOKE=2 Past or 3 Current).
F2CIGSPD.$comment: Steward gave the real question wording directly: 'About how many cigarettes do you/did you smoke on average each day? (if you are an ex-smoker, how many did you smoke on average when you smoked?)' -- explicitly applicable to both current AND past smokers, unlike recruitment's simpler RCIGSPD wording. This is a real, different skip shape from either other table's smoking pair -- D093, not transplanted from D035 or D062.
